settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure proxy behaviour and SSL certificates
settings.colorModeDesc: Color mode used in the interface.
settings.languageDesc: Display language for the Saeng interface.
settings.httpsEnabledDesc: Intercept HTTPS traffic with a local CA cert. Requires browser trust step below.
settings.startOnLaunchDesc: Automatically start the proxy when Saeng opens.
settings.loggingEnabledDesc: Record proxied requests in the request log.
settings.logMaxEntriesDesc: Number of recent requests to keep in the request log ({min}-{max}).
settings.caDesc: To serve HTTPS on local domains, Saeng generates a local CA certificate. You must install and trust it in your system keychain once.
settings.regenerateCaConfirm: This will delete the current CA certificate and all per-domain certificates. You will need to re-trust the new certificate in your browser. Continue?
settings.deleteCaConfirm: This will remove the CA certificate from your trust store and delete all certificate files. HTTPS will not work until you regenerate and re-trust a new certificate. Continue?
settings.caPlatformNoteMac: On macOS: installs into System Keychain (requires your password).
settings.caPlatformNoteWindows: On Windows: runs certutil with UAC elevation.

form.httpsHint: Enable only if your backend service itself runs HTTPS. Leave off for plain HTTP backends (even if the domain is accessed via HTTPS).
